title: Ubungqina Bomlilo
intro: Umntu ozinikeleyo, ozinikele ekufumaneni inyaniso yokugqibela, waqalisa uhambo lokufumanisa izinto zokomoya. Ukuqiniseka kwabo okungagungqiyo kwabakhokelela ekubeni baphikise imigaqo esele imiselwe, bejamelene nezilingo ezinkulu ezazivavanya imida yokholo. Ibali lomphefumlo lingqina lokukhuselwa nokukhokelwa nguThixo.
clues: Ndisikelelwe ngesibizo esikhethekileyo esivela eNkosini yam, esibonisa ulwalamano olunzulu nolukhethekileyo.
Ubomi bam bobutsha ndabuchitha phakathi kwabantu ababequbuda kwimifanekiso eyenziweyo, kodwa intliziyo yam yayilangazelela uThixo Oyedwa Oyinyaniso.
Ndazijonga izidalwa zasezulwini, ilanga, inyanga, neenkwenkwezi, ndicinga ngokunyuka nokuwa kwazo, ndigqiba kwelokuba azinakuba yiNkosi yam.
Kwisenzo sokuchasa unqulo olusasazekileyo, ndajongana noothixo bobuxoki, ndishiya omnye omkhulu, oyedwa, engathi ngumtyholi othuleyo.
Umngeni wam wokunqula izithixo wakhokelela kwisohlwayo esiqatha, njengoko ndagwetywa ukuba ndiphoswe esihogweni esivuthayo.
Sekunjalo, ngokomyalelo woMdali wam, amalangatye anamandla aguquka aba ngumthombo wokuphola nokhuseleko, elondoloza ubomi bam.
arabic: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًۭا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verse: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire." (37:97)
